source.note: Page readable but is the closed/holding version of the summer SWE NYC internship posting. A live 'Summer 2027' posting could not be located: janestreet.com open-roles list is JS-rendered (blocked), and Jane Street's Greenhouse board (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/janestreet/jobs, read 2026-07-29) showed no SWE/Trading/QR summer internship entries — only ML Researcher (HKG), Cybersecurity Analyst (NYC), Data Engineer (NYC) summer internships.

process.quote: After applying to Jane Street, you can expect to hear from a recruiter in just a few days. If you are selected for an interview, that recruiter will communicate with you clearly what to expect next.

cooling_off.quote: We usually recommend waiting to reapply for at least a year (in the case of current students), or until your experience or circumstances have significantly changed (in the case of experienced hires).
cooling_off.notes: Framed as a recommendation, not a bar. Companion FAQ quote from same page: 'Can I reinterview if I was rejected? How long do I have to wait before I can reapply? You can absolutely reinterview if it didn't work out the first time around.' Also: 'We have several success stories of people who are hired their second or even third time around. We do encourage you to consider if you're a new candidate when you reapply, have you had new experiences in the classroom or professionally that will make your resume and your candidacy different from the last time you applied?' No assessment-retake rule found; scope not explicitly bounded by Jane Street, 'all_roles' is an inference from the quote's generality.
